p: There are two methods of getting RPC onto Steam Hardware,
The Decky Plugin which requires Discord opened
Steam Presence which uses Steam's API to get now playing data and can be ran on another pc
You can install the Decky Plugin by having Decky Loader installed and installing it from the plugin store.
You can get Steam Presence via this GitHub repo
The installation steps depends on your OS
Running this on the Steam Deck requires Discord opened losing battery life
